name: My Forked Dating Life
summary: In this interactive romantic comedy, Wyatt, a biker with a disability, wheels through the dating scene with style and confidence, only he’s not in control of who he dates next… you are!  Help Wyatt navigate the awkwardness of dating and online profiles on the dating site "Sausage and Muffins." With hilarious dating profile videos from Madyson, a hippie who runs a pet shop, and Olivia, a blunt but charming writer, Wyatt finds himself on a wild adventure to find love and share the moments with someone special
